title: FraudShield
label: FinTech · ML
description: An intelligent bank transaction monitoring system that detects and flags fraudulent activity in real time using XGBoost. Features a three-tier severity flag system, REST API powered by Flask, and a MERN dashboard for analyst review.

title: CampusConnect
label: EdTech Platform
description: A collaborative platform for college students to join subject-specific rooms, post questions, share resources, and get peer answers. Built with real-time updates and a clean feed-style UI.

title: AskAI
label: AI · Productivity
description: A minimalist AI chat interface powered by the Gemini API that lets users ask questions, summarize text, and generate content. Features conversation history, markdown rendering, and a terminal-inspired UI.
